title: The Double Drop Anew
author: Zephyrine Underhill
blurb: Mara Dunmore, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
